violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: salad mix (46F) stored on ice/ cold plate front serving line.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM relocated salad mix to Trauslen 2 Dr UR refrigerator to cool back to 41F or below and replaced with another container of salad mix (40F) at the front serving line.

violations.title: Jewelry
violations.observation: Employees observed wearing jewelry on their arms and hands (wearing watch) while preparing/ serving food.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall limit their jewelry to a plain wedding ring while preparing food. Food employees may not wear bracelets, watches, etc. because they can inhibit proper hand washing. CDI: CFM instructed food employee to remove watch, wash hands, and change gloves before returns to preparing/ serving food.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Water Temp
violations.observation: The GHOT WATER AT THE handwashing sinks KITCHEN and kitchen restroom, is below 100F .
violations.corrective_action: A handwashing sink shall be equipped to provide water at a temperature of at least 100F through a mixing valve or combination faucet.
